summary: Production-hardening validation for KAZO Marketplace Finance platform. Backend: 29/29 pytest tests PASSED (15 legacy + 14 new). New tests cover monthly reports (list/detail/xlsx export), unmapped-order flags & summary, report_month filters on calculations/reconciliation, settlement-settings and tax-rates CRUD, and master seed counts. Frontend: all data-testids from spec present and functional on Overview, Reports (/reports), Calculations (unmapped-only filter), Masters (Settlement Config + Tax Rates tabs). Data integrity verified — 14,219 sales orders in 2026-04, 37 unmapped (0.26% ratio, well under 1% threshold, all Clothing Set variants), 260 discrepancies with ₹5,056.12 recoverable. Commission rules count = 173 (>=170 required). All KPI values on monthly report non-zero (NSV ₹2.61Cr, Commission ₹31.5L incl 18% GST, Settlement ₹1.94Cr with 74.2% margin). Excel export returns valid xlsx with all 7 required sheets (Summary, By Category, By Sub-Category, By Zone, Order Detail, Discrepancies, Unmapped Orders).

issues: Recharts still emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial render — carried over from iteration 1, cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: reports.py: `_month_aggregate` runs 6 sequential Mongo aggregations serially; could be parallelised with asyncio.gather for faster response on months with millions of rows.

reports.py export_monthly: loads ALL calculations for the month into memory (to_list(100000)) then all sales by id; for very large months this will spike memory. Consider streaming or chunked iteration when >50k orders.
reports.py line 296-299: dead loop `for col_i, key in enumerate([...]): pass` — leftover from refactor, safe but should be removed.

masters.py POST /masters/reset-defaults is destructive but has NO auth dependency at router level — anyone hitting the URL can wipe all masters. Add Depends(current_user) with role='admin' check. Task spec explicitly calls this out as required.

masters.py: same missing-auth concern applies to all POST/DELETE endpoints (commission-rules, fixed-fees, gt-charges, return-fees, subcat-levels, tolerance, tax-rates, settlement-settings). Iteration 1 also flagged this — still unresolved.
reports.py: bad-month handling only validates length==7, not format. e.g. 'abc-def' passes length check and would return empty aggregates instead of 400. Use a regex `^\d{4}-\d{2}$`.

calculations engine (per spec): verified commission engine returns unmapped=True with reasons rather than falling back to 0 — confirmed via /api/calculations?unmapped_only=true returning 37 rows all with Clothing Set (no matching commission rule).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testids present, all pages render, download button wired)

seed_data_creation: None — reused existing 14,219 sales / 296 settlement rows / 173 commission rules / 260 discrepancies from prior iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green (29 pytest tests). All new production-hardening endpoints tested: /api/reports/months, /api/reports/monthly, /api/reports/monthly/export (xlsx), /api/calculations/unmapped-summary, /api/calculations?unmapped_only, /api/masters/settlement-settings (GET+POST), /api/masters/tax-rates (GET+POST), /api/masters/reset-defaults. Unmapped ratio is 37/14219 = 0.26% (all Clothing Set — no commission rules for that sub-cat in master file). Frontend uses data-testids: overview-month-select, unmapped-banner, link-view-reports, nav-reports, reports-page, report-month-select, kpi-{nsv,commission,deductions,settlement}, btn-download-report, calc-month-select, chk-unmapped-only, tab-settlement, tab-tax, input-default-zone, input-dash-as-missing, input-apply-default-zone, btn-save-settlement — all confirmed present and functional. Only outstanding concern is auth-protection on write endpoints (see critical_code_review_comments).
